Werebear (CV 29)

A broad bear-headed guardian has a woodcutter's patient stance and a voice that grows rough whenever fear takes over.

Attributes: Brawn +2; Fortitude +2; Agility +0; Guile -1; Knowledge -1; Reason +0

HP: 32 · Speed: 7 · Size: 1 (medium) · Armor DR: 1

Evasion: None · Threat: 1 Bane · Stability: 1

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: Physical (1)\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates a complete outcome. All attacks use printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Heavy forepaw

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Push 3. Standard defense: Push 1.

Limit: Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision rules to the printed distance.

Change Guise

The creature shifts between a familiar face and its hybrid shape.

Change between humanoid and hybrid appearance. Keep current HP, attributes, resistances, conditions and printed movement; no healing or refreshed resources. Natural attacks require hybrid form; held weapon attacks and Basic Melee remain available in humanoid form. Equipment remains carried or worn where it fits. No infection or extra inventory capacity.

Shelter the Young

It turns at the cry beside it, bringing its whole body between the danger and the one it protects.

After a visible enemy ends voluntary movement adjacent to a willing ally within 3 squares, move up to 2 squares, ending adjacent to that ally. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally. This movement grants no attack or automatic protection; its body obstructs only the squares it actually occupies. Movement granted by a free attack cannot trigger it.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

Heavy Frame — Passive: Stability 1; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Tactics and retreat: Use hybrid form to push threats away from the refuge, then return to a recognizable face when someone offers needed supplies.

Encounter and conversation: It is keeping travelers away from a refuge, but has frightened away the people bringing much-needed medicine.

Habitat: Settlement; frontier; contested road · Communication: Common and its community’s language

Loot: Ordinary carried gear and 8 coins; special rewards belong to the adventure.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play

ID: creature-werebear

Category: Mortal · Role: Displacer · CV: 29
